senses.en: very unhappy, sometimes persistently as part of a mental illness
having little economic activity or few opportunities

ex.en: He felt depressed after weeks of unsuccessful job hunting.
Investment in public transport can connect economically depressed areas with employment opportunities and essential services.

col: economically depressed area｜khu vực kinh tế suy thoái
tip: depressed mô tả cảm xúc của người; depressing mô tả điều gây chán nản.

senses.en: Extremely good, impressive, or enjoyable.

senses.zh: tài giỏi; thông minh xuất chúng
senses.en: Exceptionally intelligent or skilled.
Shining brightly or having a strong, vivid colour.

ex.en: Your brilliant idea saved us hours of work.
Brilliant teachers can inspire students to explore difficult subjects with confidence and genuine curiosity.

col: brilliant scientist｜nhà khoa học xuất sắc
tip: Trong khẩu ngữ Anh-Anh, brilliant thường dùng với nghĩa “tuyệt quá”.

senses.en: an object played to produce musical sounds

senses.zh: dụng cụ; thiết bị (khoa học, y tế)
senses.en: a tool or device for precise scientific or medical work
something used to achieve a particular purpose

ex.en: My sister plays a different instrument at each rehearsal.
Learning a musical instrument can strengthen concentration and encourage cooperation among children from different backgrounds.

col: instrument of change｜công cụ thúc đẩy thay đổi
tip: Nhạc cụ và dụng cụ chính xác đều dùng instrument; dụng cụ thông thường hay dùng tool.

senses.en: A man who is engaged to be married.

ex.en: My fiance and I are choosing wedding flowers.
Moving abroad with a fiance can require careful planning around employment, housing, and future family responsibilities.

col: her fiance｜hôn phu của cô ấy
my fiance and I｜tôi và hôn phu của tôi
tip: Còn viết là fiancé; hôn thê (vợ chưa cưới) là fiancee hoặc fiancée.

senses.en: An aircraft powered by jet engines.
A narrow, forceful stream of liquid or gas.

ex.en: A jet flew low over the beach this morning.
Replacing older passenger jets with more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption across the aviation industry.

col: passenger jet｜máy bay phản lực chở khách
a jet of water｜một tia nước phun ra
tip: a jet of water nghĩa là một tia nước phun ra.

senses.zh: vụ va chạm; vụ rơi (máy bay)
senses.en: an accident in which a vehicle hits something or falls
to hit something violently or fall and be badly damaged
to stop working suddenly or lose value very quickly

ex.en: Nobody was hurt in the crash outside our house.
Financial markets can crash when investors suddenly lose confidence in the stability of the economy.

col: a car crash｜tai nạn xe hơi
crash into a wall｜đâm vào tường
a computer crash｜máy tính bị treo
a stock market crash｜thị trường chứng khoán sụp đổ
tip: crash into theo sau là vật bị đâm vào; máy tính bị treo cũng dùng crash.

senses.en: To want something or feel like doing something.
Decorative, elaborate, or expensive rather than plain.
To feel romantically attracted to someone.

ex.en: Do you fancy a walk by the river after lunch?
Some tourists prefer simple local accommodation to fancy hotels because it offers more opportunities for cultural exchange.

col: fancy a drink｜muốn uống chút gì
a fancy restaurant｜một nhà hàng sang trọng
tip: Khi nghĩa là “muốn làm gì” thì dùng fancy doing, không dùng fancy to do.

senses.zh: sự phản đối; cuộc biểu tình
senses.en: An expression or action showing strong disagreement or opposition.
Express strong disagreement with something.

ex.en: Residents held a peaceful protest outside the town hall.
Citizens may protest against environmental policies that fail to protect local forests and water supplies.

col: under protest｜miễn cưỡng; trong sự phản đối
tip: Mục này là danh từ; động từ phát âm /prəˈtest/ trong Anh-Anh, thường đi với against.

senses.zh: tù nhân; người bị giam giữ
senses.en: A person kept in prison or prevented from leaving.
A person captured and held by an enemy during war.

ex.en: The prisoner borrowed a novel from the prison library.
Providing prisoners with education and vocational training may improve their chances of finding employment after release.

col: prisoner of war｜tù binh chiến tranh
take someone prisoner｜bắt ai làm tù binh
tip: prisoner không nhất thiết đã bị kết án; cũng có thể chỉ người bị bắt giữ hoặc giam giữ.

senses.en: Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time.
Expected to happen or arrive at a particular time.
Deserved or appropriate in a particular situation.

ex.en: Our rent is due at the end of the week.
When tuition fees are due, some students struggle to cover both educational expenses and basic living costs.

col: payment due｜khoản thanh toán đến hạn
due consideration｜sự cân nhắc thích đáng
tip: be due to do nghĩa là dự kiến làm gì; due to + danh từ nghĩa là “do, bởi vì”.

senses.en: a person trained to travel and work in space

ex.en: The astronaut floated gently through the small space station.
Astronauts conduct experiments in space that help scientists understand how the human body responds to weightlessness.

col: astronaut training｜huấn luyện phi hành gia
a team of astronauts｜một nhóm phi hành gia
tip: astronaut là phi hành gia; astronomer là nhà thiên văn học.

senses.en: be or move into positions on every side of something
be closely connected with an event, situation, or subject

ex.en: Tall trees surround the cottage and shade its windows.
Uncertainty continues to surround the proposed transport scheme, making it difficult for local businesses to plan ahead.

col: be surrounded by｜bị bao quanh bởi
surround yourself with｜tự bao quanh mình bằng
the circumstances surrounding｜hoàn cảnh xoay quanh
tip: Thường dùng be surrounded by; surroundings là môi trường xung quanh.

senses.en: to need someone's help or depend on something
to trust someone or something to act as expected

ex.en: I rely on my bicycle to get to work.
Communities that rely heavily on tourism may face economic difficulties when visitor numbers suddenly decline.

col: rely heavily on｜phụ thuộc nhiều vào
rely on someone to do something｜trông cậy ai làm gì
tip: Không đi trực tiếp với tân ngữ: dùng rely on hoặc rely upon.

senses.en: Tasting of salt or containing a lot of salt.

ex.en: The soup was too salty, so I added water.
Eating salty snacks frequently can contribute to high blood pressure, increasing the risk of cardiovascular disease.

tip: salty nhấn mạnh vị mặn; salted nhấn mạnh là đã được thêm muối.

senses.en: To tell someone you are sorry for doing something wrong

ex.en: I apologized to my neighbour for the noise.
Companies should apologize promptly for service failures and explain what steps they will take to prevent further problems.

col: apologize for doing something｜xin lỗi vì đã làm gì
tip: Xin lỗi ai dùng to, xin lỗi vì điều gì dùng for; Anh-Anh còn viết là apologise.

senses.en: A person from a country other than the one being discussed.

ex.en: As a foreigner, I needed help understanding local customs.
Language courses can help foreigners participate more fully in community life and access essential public services.

col: as a foreigner｜với tư cách là người nước ngoài
foreigners living abroad｜người nước ngoài sống ở nước ngoài
welcome foreigners｜chào đón người nước ngoài
tip: Chỉ chung người nước ngoài; khi nói riêng về khách du lịch, dùng visitor sẽ tự nhiên hơn.

senses.en: Having formally agreed to marry someone.
Actively involved in an activity or task.

senses.zh: bận máy; đang được sử dụng
senses.en: Currently being used and therefore unavailable.

ex.en: My sister got engaged during her holiday by the sea.
Students who are actively engaged in classroom discussions often develop stronger communication and critical thinking skills.

col: engaged to someone｜đã đính hôn với ai
engaged in research｜tham gia nghiên cứu
tip: Đính hôn với ai dùng to; tham gia hoạt động gì dùng in.

senses.en: In every part of a place or during an entire period.

senses.zh: khắp nơi; từ đầu đến cuối
senses.en: In every part or for the whole time.

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread spread throughout the house.
Reliable internet access throughout rural areas is essential for reducing inequalities in education and employment.

col: remain consistent throughout｜luôn nhất quán từ đầu đến cuối
tip: throughout nhấn mạnh toàn bộ phạm vi hoặc suốt cả quá trình, không chỉ một điểm.

senses.en: someone who behaves without good sense or judgment
to make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: The realistic plastic spider fooled everyone at the party.
Misleading advertisements can fool consumers into buying products that offer little practical benefit.

col: fool someone into doing something｜lừa ai làm gì
make a fool of yourself｜làm trò cười cho thiên hạ
tip: Gọi ai là fool là mang nghĩa xúc phạm; động từ có thể đi với into doing.

senses.en: to be convenient or right for someone
to make someone look attractive
matching clothes consisting of a jacket and trousers or skirt

ex.en: Would an earlier appointment suit you better tomorrow?
Flexible working hours suit employees who need to balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.

col: suit your needs｜phù hợp với nhu cầu của bạn
suit everyone｜phù hợp với mọi người
a business suit｜bộ com-lê công sở
tip: suit nhấn mạnh sự phù hợp hoặc hợp với dáng vẻ; fit nhấn mạnh vừa kích cỡ.

senses.en: Time when you are not working or attending school.

ex.en: I need some time off to visit my grandparents.
Providing paid time off can improve employee wellbeing and reduce stress in the workplace.

col: paid time off｜nghỉ phép có lương
time off work｜thời gian nghỉ làm
tip: Thường không đếm được; xin nghỉ một ngày thì nói take a day off.

senses.en: To move someone or something from one place to another.
To change to another vehicle, school, or institution.

senses.zh: sự chuyển; sự điều chuyển; sự chuyển khoản
senses.en: The act of moving something or someone to another place.

ex.en: Please transfer the photos from your camera to my laptop.
Governments should support the transfer of clean technology to regions that still depend heavily on fossil fuels.

col: transfer to another school｜chuyển sang trường khác
tip: Danh từ nhấn trọng âm ở âm đầu; quá khứ transferred gấp đôi chữ r.

senses.zh: lãng mạn; thuộc về tình yêu
senses.en: connected with love or expressing loving feelings
seeing things as more beautiful or exciting than they really are

senses.zh: người lãng mạn; người theo chủ nghĩa lý tưởng
senses.en: someone strongly influenced by love, imagination, or idealistic hopes

ex.en: They enjoyed a romantic dinner beside the quiet lake.
Advertisements often present a romantic image of rural life while ignoring limited services and employment opportunities.

col: romantic relationship｜mối quan hệ tình cảm
a romantic view of｜cái nhìn lý tưởng hóa về
tip: Ngoài nghĩa tình yêu, còn có thể chỉ việc nghĩ thực tế tốt đẹp quá mức.

senses.en: a small round mark
to appear in scattered places across an area

senses.zh: dấu chấm (trong địa chỉ web, email)
senses.en: the spoken name for a full stop in online addresses

ex.en: Her yellow umbrella has a pattern of blue dots.
Small villages dot the coastline, attracting visitors who prefer quieter alternatives to crowded seaside resorts.

tip: on the dot nghĩa là đúng giờ, thường đứng sau một thời điểm cụ thể.

senses.zh: sự tăng trưởng; sự gia tăng
senses.en: An increase in size, amount, or level.

senses.zh: sự phát triển; sự lớn lên
senses.en: The process of growing physically or developing over time.
An unusual lump of tissue growing in or on the body.

ex.en: The rapid growth of our town surprised my grandparents.
Governments should balance economic growth with environmental protection to ensure that rising prosperity does not exhaust natural resources.

col: personal growth｜sự trưởng thành của cá nhân
tip: Nghĩa “tăng trưởng” thường không đếm được; a growth có thể chỉ một khối u.

senses.en: a story, especially one involving imaginary or exciting events
an account of something that happened to someone

ex.en: Grandfather told us a tale about a clever fox.
Traditional tales can preserve cultural values while helping children explore complex emotions through memorable characters.

col: a cautionary tale｜câu chuyện răn dạy
tip: tale là câu chuyện; tail là cái đuôi, hai từ đồng âm.

senses.en: At a time before now or before another event.

ex.en: I had previously met our neighbour at the library.
Online courses now provide educational opportunities for people who previously had limited access to universities.

col: previously mentioned｜đã đề cập trước đó
previously published｜đã được công bố trước đó
tip: previously nghĩa là trước đây; chuẩn bị sẵn từ trước thường dùng in advance.

senses.en: a dirty or coloured mark that is difficult to remove
to leave a lasting mark or colour on something
a substance used to colour wood or biological samples

ex.en: There is a coffee stain on your white shirt.
Manufacturers are developing fabrics that resist stains, potentially reducing the water and energy required for washing.

tip: Vết bẩn gọi là stain; màu thông thường không gọi là stain, còn chất nhuộm thì có.

senses.en: happening or existing before the time or thing being discussed

ex.en: The previous tenant left some plants on the balcony.
Previous studies suggest that regular physical activity can improve concentration and academic performance among school children.

tip: previous là tính từ; muốn nói “trước đây” dùng trạng từ previously.

senses.en: a rodent with a long tail, larger than a mouse

ex.en: A rat disappeared behind the bins near the gate.
Proper waste management helps control rat populations and reduces health risks in densely populated neighbourhoods.

tip: rat thường là chuột to (chuột cống), còn mouse là chuột nhắt nhỏ hơn.

senses.en: A person who does not eat meat or fish.
Containing no meat or fish, or following this diet.

ex.en: My sister became a vegetarian after learning to cook.
Providing vegetarian meals in school canteens can accommodate different dietary preferences and reduce environmental impacts.

col: become a vegetarian｜trở thành người ăn chay
tip: vegetarian không ăn thịt và cá; vegan còn không ăn trứng, sữa và các sản phẩm động vật.

senses.en: a darker skin colour caused by exposure to the sun
to become or make skin darker through exposure to sunlight
having a light brown colour

ex.en: His summer tan had faded by the middle of winter.
Although a tan is sometimes considered attractive, prolonged exposure to sunlight increases the risk of skin damage.

col: a deep tan｜làn da rám nắng đậm
tan leather｜da thuộc màu nâu vàng
tip: tan không chỉ nói về da cháy nắng; làm tính từ còn tả màu nâu nhạt của giày, túi.

senses.en: the activity of swimming underwater, often using special breathing equipment
the sport of jumping into water, often with controlled movements

ex.en: We went diving and saw colourful fish near the reef.
Diving tourism can support coastal economies, provided operators protect marine habitats and teach visitors responsible behaviour.

col: a diving instructor｜huấn luyện viên lặn
tip: go diving thường là đi lặn; môn nhảy cầu cũng gọi là diving.

senses.en: to welcome someone or say hello

senses.zh: đập vào mắt; đập vào tai và mũi
senses.en: to become noticeable when someone arrives or looks

ex.en: Our neighbours greeted us warmly when we moved in.
Visitors are greeted by trained volunteers who explain the museum's collection and help them find their way.

col: greet someone warmly｜chào ai nồng nhiệt
greet someone with a smile｜chào đón ai bằng nụ cười
be greeted by｜được chào đón bởi; thấy đầu tiên
tip: greet đi thẳng với người, không thêm to khi nói chào ai.

senses.en: A small booklet giving information about products, services, or places.

ex.en: I picked up a travel brochure at the station.
University brochures can help prospective students compare courses, accommodation options, and the facilities available on campus.

col: travel brochure｜tập giới thiệu du lịch
university brochure｜cẩm nang tuyển sinh đại học
tip: Danh từ đếm được, thường chỉ tập sách mỏng giới thiệu du lịch, khóa học hoặc sản phẩm.

senses.en: A small beetle, often red with black spots

ex.en: A tiny ladybird landed on the edge of my sleeve.
Ladybirds can help farmers control certain crop pests, reducing the need for chemical pesticides.

col: a red ladybird｜một con bọ rùa đỏ
a seven-spot ladybird｜bọ rùa bảy chấm
tip: Anh-Anh thường dùng ladybird, Anh-Mỹ thường dùng ladybug.

senses.en: The part of a garment that covers an arm.
A protective cover that fits closely around an object.

ex.en: I caught my sleeve on the kitchen door handle.
Workers should keep loose sleeves away from moving machinery to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.

col: roll up your sleeves｜xắn tay áo
tip: sleeve là tay áo của quần áo, không phải cánh tay (arm).

senses.en: A sound, movement, or light that communicates a message.
An electrical or radio wave carrying information.
Communicate through an action, or indicate that something is happening.

ex.en: The coach gave a signal, and we started running.
Increasing investment in renewable energy may signal a government's commitment to reducing its dependence on fossil fuels.

col: signal a change｜báo hiệu một thay đổi
tip: Quá khứ trong Anh-Anh thường viết signalled, trong Anh-Mỹ thường viết signaled.

senses.en: a formal test of knowledge or ability

senses.zh: sự kiểm tra; sự xem xét kỹ
senses.en: the act of looking at something carefully to assess it

ex.en: She felt relieved when her final examination was over.
A detailed examination of local housing conditions can help governments identify communities that need urgent support.

tip: Nghĩa kỳ thi thường rút gọn thành exam; nghĩa kiểm tra thường đi với of.

senses.en: Thick, stiff paper used for boxes and packaging

ex.en: We cut the cardboard into shapes for a model house.
Replacing plastic packaging with recycled cardboard can reduce waste and encourage more sustainable consumption.

col: a sheet of cardboard｜một tấm bìa các-tông
tip: Thường không đếm được; một tấm thì nói a sheet of cardboard.

senses.en: having a duty to manage or look after something

senses.zh: là nguyên nhân; phải chịu trách nhiệm
senses.en: being the cause of something, especially something bad

senses.zh: đáng tin cậy; có trách nhiệm
senses.en: sensible and trustworthy in your actions and decisions

ex.en: I'm responsible for feeding our cat every morning.
Governments are responsible for ensuring that all children have access to safe and affordable education.

col: responsible behaviour｜hành vi có trách nhiệm
hold someone responsible｜coi ai phải chịu trách nhiệm
tip: responsible for theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ; to theo sau là cấp trên.

senses.zh: thuộc điện tử; thiết bị điện tử
senses.en: using circuits to control electrical signals

senses.zh: dưới dạng điện tử; số hóa
senses.en: stored, sent, or accessed using computers

ex.en: Please switch off your electronic devices during the performance.
Electronic health records can help doctors share information efficiently, but strong safeguards are needed to protect patient privacy.

tip: electronic nhấn mạnh mạch điện tử; electric chỉ chung việc chạy bằng điện.

senses.en: Using a temperature scale where water freezes at thirty-two degrees
The temperature scale with water boiling at two hundred twelve degrees

ex.en: The recipe says to bake at three hundred degrees Fahrenheit.
International weather reports may provide temperatures in both Fahrenheit and Celsius to serve different audiences.

col: convert Fahrenheit to Celsius｜đổi độ F sang độ C
tip: Chỉ thang nhiệt độ Fahrenheit, không phải nhiệt kế; luôn viết hoa chữ đầu.

senses.en: Close to a particular amount, but not exactly.

ex.en: The walk to the lake takes approximately twenty minutes.
Approximately half of the households surveyed reported using public transport at least once a week.

tip: Thường đứng trước số lượng, trang trọng hơn about.

senses.en: a long passage connecting rooms inside a building

senses.zh: dải đất hẹp; hành lang (địa lý)
senses.en: a strip of land connecting areas for movement or transport

ex.en: Her footsteps echoed along the empty corridor after class.
Wildlife corridors allow animals to move safely between habitats that roads and urban development have separated.

col: a narrow corridor｜một hành lang hẹp
along the corridor｜dọc theo hành lang
a wildlife corridor｜hành lang động vật hoang dã
a transport corridor｜hành lang giao thông
tip: Vừa chỉ hành lang trong tòa nhà, vừa chỉ dải đất dài hẹp nối các khu vực.

senses.en: To mark an item as correct, or make repeated clicking sounds.
A mark showing correctness, or a short sound a clock makes.
A small creature that attaches to skin and feeds on blood.

ex.en: The old clock ticks softly beside my bed.
Participants should tick the appropriate boxes to indicate how frequently they use public transport.

col: tick a box｜đánh dấu vào ô
a tick bite｜vết cắn của bọ ve
a clock ticks｜đồng hồ kêu tích tắc
tip: Đánh dấu tích thường dùng tick trong Anh-Anh và check trong Anh-Mỹ.

senses.en: a powerful tropical storm with extremely strong winds

ex.en: We stayed indoors as the hurricane approached the coast.
Coastal cities need stronger flood defences and reliable warning systems to protect residents when a hurricane approaches.

tip: hurricane và typhoon đều là xoáy thuận nhiệt đới, tên gọi khác nhau theo vùng biển.

senses.en: the collection of sacred writings used in Christianity

ex.en: She keeps a Bible on the shelf beside her bed.
Studying the Bible can help students understand religious references in European literature and visual art.

col: a Bible translation｜bản dịch Kinh Thánh
tip: Khi chỉ Kinh Thánh thì viết hoa chữ đầu, thường dùng the Bible.

senses.zh: lời cảnh báo; sự nhắc nhở
senses.en: Something said or done to alert someone to danger or problems.

senses.zh: điềm báo; tín hiệu cảnh báo
senses.en: A sign that something harmful or unpleasant may happen.

ex.en: We turned back after the guide's warning about slippery rocks.
Effective flood warning systems allow residents to leave dangerous areas before roads become impossible to use.

col: issue a warning｜đưa ra cảnh báo
early warning system｜hệ thống cảnh báo sớm
heed a warning｜nghe theo lời cảnh báo
tip: warning là danh từ; cũng có thể là phân từ hiện tại của warn.

senses.en: to tell a story or describe events again

ex.en: My grandmother retells her favourite story every winter.
Asking students to retell a story in their own words can improve comprehension and speaking skills.

col: retell a story｜kể lại một câu chuyện
retell events｜thuật lại các sự kiện
retell in your own words｜kể lại bằng lời của mình
tip: Quá khứ và phân từ quá khứ đều là retold.

senses.en: A device that makes recorded or transmitted sound audible

ex.en: A voice from the loudspeaker announced our train's arrival.
Public transport stations use loudspeaker systems to communicate urgent safety information to large numbers of passengers.

col: over the loudspeaker｜qua loa phóng thanh
tip: loudspeaker chỉ thiết bị; speaker còn có thể chỉ người phát biểu.

senses.en: material made of crossing threads with spaces between them

senses.zh: ròng; sau khi trừ chi phí
senses.en: remaining after costs, taxes, or other amounts have been deducted

senses.zh: kiếm được (lợi nhuận ròng); thu về
senses.en: to earn as profit or successfully obtain something

ex.en: A small silver fish wriggled inside the fishing net.
The company increased its net profit by reducing energy consumption rather than raising prices for customers.

tip: net chỉ số tiền ròng sau khi trừ chi phí hoặc thuế; gross là tổng trước khi trừ.

senses.zh: sự giao hàng; sự chuyển phát
senses.en: the act of taking goods or messages to someone
the process of giving birth to a baby

senses.zh: cách diễn đạt; cách trình bày
senses.en: the way someone speaks or performs in public

ex.en: Our grocery delivery arrived just before we started cooking.
The growing demand for home delivery has increased traffic congestion in many urban neighbourhoods.

col: a smooth delivery｜ca sinh nở suôn sẻ
tip: delivery chỉ dịch vụ hoặc quá trình giao hàng; deliver là động từ.

senses.en: the grounds and buildings belonging to a university or college

ex.en: We found a quiet bench near the campus library.
Providing affordable accommodation on campus can help students spend less time commuting and more time studying.

col: campus facilities｜cơ sở vật chất trong trường
tip: Nói “trong khuôn viên trường” thường dùng on campus, không có mạo từ.

senses.zh: sự giống nhau; điểm tương đồng
senses.en: The state of being alike, or a shared feature

ex.en: The similarity between these two jackets surprised me.
Despite their geographical distance, the two regions show striking similarities in traditional farming methods.

col: striking similarity｜sự giống nhau đáng kinh ngạc
tip: Sự giống nhau thường không đếm được; điểm tương đồng cụ thể thì đếm được, thường dùng số nhiều.

senses.en: an object used for fighting or causing physical harm

ex.en: The museum displays an ancient weapon behind thick glass.
Stricter controls on weapon sales may help governments improve public safety and reduce violent crime.

col: carry a weapon｜mang theo vũ khí
tip: Danh từ đếm được; từ chỉ chung vũ khí còn có weaponry.

senses.zh: riêng tôi thì; theo cá nhân tôi
senses.en: used to introduce your own opinion or preference
by a particular person rather than someone acting for them

senses.zh: mang tính cá nhân; nhắm vào cá nhân
senses.en: as relating to someone's character rather than their actions

ex.en: Personally, I prefer walking to taking the bus.
Personally, I believe that public libraries remain essential because they provide free access to reliable information.

col: personally speaking｜nói riêng cá nhân tôi
take something personally｜cho rằng điều gì đó nhắm vào mình
personally responsible｜chịu trách nhiệm cá nhân
know someone personally｜quen biết ai trực tiếp
tip: take it personally nghĩa là coi chuyện đó là nhắm vào mình.

senses.en: the passage inside the neck through which air and food pass

ex.en: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.

tip: Bị đau họng dùng have a sore throat, chú ý mạo từ a.

senses.en: to have enough courage to do something
to challenge someone to do something requiring courage
a challenge to do something difficult or frightening

ex.en: I finally dared to sing in front of everyone.
Students are more likely to dare to question established ideas when teachers welcome respectful disagreement.

col: dare someone to do something｜thách ai làm gì
tip: Dám làm gì dùng dare to do; thách ai làm gì dùng dare sb to do.

senses.en: believing in your own ability to succeed
certain that something is true or will happen

ex.en: After weeks of practice, I felt confident on stage.
Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.

col: confident about the future｜tự tin về tương lai
tip: confident là tính từ; confidence là danh từ.

senses.en: a pointed symbol showing direction
a thin pointed object shot from a bow

ex.en: Follow the arrow on the floor to the exit.
Clear arrows on station floors can improve passenger flow and reduce confusion during busy commuting periods.

col: follow the arrow｜đi theo mũi tên
an arrow points to｜mũi tên chỉ tới
tip: arrow vừa là mũi tên bắn từ cung, vừa là ký hiệu mũi tên chỉ hướng.

senses.en: a mark showing achievement, or a level of quality
a school year level, especially in the American system
to assess work or sort things by quality

ex.en: I got a good grade on my science project.
Teachers should grade assignments consistently so that students understand how their performance is assessed across different subjects.

col: get a good grade｜đạt điểm tốt
high-grade materials｜vật liệu chất lượng cao
tip: Nghĩa “lớp” chủ yếu dùng trong Anh-Mỹ; Anh-Anh thường dùng year.

senses.en: one part of a television or radio series
a particular event or period within a longer story
a period when someone experiences a particular illness or symptom

ex.en: We watched the final episode together after dinner.
Each episode of the documentary explores how urban development affects wildlife in different parts of the world.

col: a brief episode｜một giai đoạn ngắn
tip: episode là một tập; series là cả loạt phim hoặc chương trình.

senses.en: a structure that surrounds or supports something
to put a picture or similar object inside a frame
to express or present something in a particular way

ex.en: We chose a wooden frame for our family photograph.
The way journalists frame environmental issues can influence public attitudes towards conservation and government policy.

col: frame a question｜diễn đạt một câu hỏi
a frame of reference｜hệ quy chiếu
tip: frame vừa chỉ khung thực tế vừa chỉ cách trình bày một vấn đề.

senses.en: The natural features of a place considered for their beauty.
Painted backgrounds and structures that create a play's setting.

ex.en: We stopped by the lake to admire the scenery.
Protecting natural scenery can attract responsible tourism while preserving valuable habitats for local wildlife.

tip: scenery là danh từ không đếm được, không nói a scenery hay sceneries.

senses.en: Someone in a romantic or sexual relationship with another person.

senses.zh: người yêu thích; người hâm mộ
senses.en: Someone who enjoys or admires something very much.

ex.en: The two lovers walked hand in hand beside the river.
Public gardens offer nature lovers valuable opportunities to observe wildlife without leaving the city.

col: a music lover｜người yêu âm nhạc
a nature lover｜người yêu thiên nhiên
tip: Chỉ người yêu thích thường dùng danh từ + lover; dùng lover một mình có thể hiểu là tình nhân.

senses.en: the joint where your arm bends
to push someone or something with your elbow

ex.en: I knocked my elbow against the kitchen door.
Passengers sometimes elbow their way onto crowded trains, making public transport uncomfortable for others.

col: rest your elbows on｜gác khuỷu tay lên
elbow your way through｜dùng khuỷu tay chen lách
tip: Khi là động từ, elbow thường chỉ việc dùng khuỷu tay chen lấn để tiến lên.

senses.zh: văn phòng phẩm; giấy viết thư và phong bì
senses.en: Materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

ex.en: I bought some stationery for my new evening class.
Providing basic stationery can help disadvantaged students participate more fully in classroom activities and complete assignments.

col: office stationery｜văn phòng phẩm công sở
stationery supplies｜đồ dùng văn phòng phẩm
stationery shop｜cửa hàng văn phòng phẩm
tip: Không đếm được; đừng nhầm với stationary (đứng yên).

senses.en: Despite the fact that something is true.
Used to introduce a contrasting point, often at sentence end.

ex.en: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
Though online courses offer greater flexibility, many students still benefit from direct interaction with teachers.

tip: Khi dẫn mệnh đề nhượng bộ thì không dùng cùng but; đặt cuối câu có nghĩa “nhưng mà”.

senses.en: Worry or demands that make someone feel forced to act
Force pressing on a surface or within a substance
Try to make someone do something through strong persuasion

ex.en: I feel pressure to answer work messages immediately.
Employers should avoid putting excessive pressure on staff, as this can damage both health and productivity.

col: put pressure on｜gây áp lực lên
pressure someone into doing something｜ép ai làm gì
tip: under pressure nghĩa là đang chịu áp lực; động từ thường đi với into doing.

senses.en: powder made by grinding grain, used especially in baking
to cover a surface or food lightly with flour

ex.en: Add the flour slowly and stir until smooth.
Replacing some refined flour with wholemeal flour can increase the fibre content of everyday foods.

col: flour a surface｜rắc bột lên mặt bàn
tip: flour thường không đếm được, đồng âm với flower.

senses.zh: tập thể dục giữ dáng; bài thể dục
senses.en: Physical exercises done to stay healthy and fit.

ex.en: My aunt attends keep-fit classes at the community centre.
Affordable keep-fit classes can encourage older adults to exercise regularly and maintain social connections within their communities.

col: keep-fit classes｜lớp thể dục giữ dáng
keep-fit exercises｜các bài tập thể dục giữ dáng
tip: Chủ yếu dùng trong Anh-Anh; cụm động từ keep fit không có gạch nối.

senses.en: red, painful skin caused by too much exposure to sunlight

ex.en: I got sunburn after spending all afternoon outside.
Public health campaigns should explain that preventing sunburn requires suitable clothing and shade as well as sunscreen.

tip: Anh-Anh thường nói get sunburn; Anh-Mỹ cũng hay nói get a sunburn.

senses.en: Putting medicine into the body using a needle.

senses.zh: sự bơm vốn; sự đầu tư thêm
senses.en: The addition of money or resources to improve something.

ex.en: The nurse gave me an injection in my arm.
An injection of public funding could help local libraries modernise their facilities and expand community services.

col: a cash injection｜khoản tiền mặt bơm vào
an injection of funding｜khoản kinh phí được bơm vào
tip: an injection of cash là cách dùng ẩn dụ, nghĩa là bơm thêm vốn.

senses.en: someone who entertains an audience by acting, singing, or playing

senses.zh: người (hoặc vật) có thành tích; người làm việc hiệu quả
senses.en: a person or thing achieving a particular level of success

ex.en: A street performer juggled oranges beside the crowded market.
Public funding can help young performers develop their skills and bring live entertainment to underserved communities.

col: a street performer｜nghệ sĩ đường phố
a live performer｜nghệ sĩ biểu diễn trực tiếp
a top performer｜người có thành tích xuất sắc
tip: Không chỉ là diễn viên; top performer còn có thể chỉ nhân viên có hiệu suất xuất sắc.

senses.en: a structure that carries smoke from a fire outside

ex.en: Smoke rose from the chimney into the cold evening air.
Installing filters in factory chimneys can reduce the amount of harmful particles released into the atmosphere.

tip: Số nhiều chỉ cần thêm -s: chimneys, không đổi y thành i.

senses.en: The distance from one end of something to the other.
The amount of time something lasts.

ex.en: We measured the length of the table before buying chairs.
The length of the school day can affect both student concentration and family routines.

col: the length of time｜khoảng thời gian dài ngắn
tip: at length thường nghĩa là “một cách chi tiết”, không phải “về chiều dài”.

senses.en: Identify someone or something known or seen before.
Accept or understand that something is true or important.

senses.zh: công nhận chính thức; ghi nhận
senses.en: Officially accept someone's status, qualifications, or achievements.

ex.en: I recognized my old teacher by her familiar laugh.
Employers should recognize the value of practical experience when assessing candidates who lack formal qualifications.

col: recognize a face｜nhận ra một gương mặt
recognize the importance of｜nhận thức tầm quan trọng của
recognize someone as｜công nhận ai là
internationally recognized｜được quốc tế công nhận
tip: Anh-Anh cũng hay viết recognise; với nghĩa “nhận ra” thường không dùng thì tiếp diễn.

senses.en: a strong feeling of surprise caused by something unexpected
to make someone feel very surprised or upset
a dangerous medical collapse, or an electrical jolt through the body

ex.en: The sudden rise in rent came as a shock.
Moving abroad can cause culture shock, particularly when everyday customs differ greatly from those at home.

col: in a state of shock｜trong trạng thái sốc
tip: Người cảm thấy sốc dùng shocked; điều gây sốc dùng shocking.

senses.en: To look after children while their parents are away.

ex.en: Could you baby-sit for us on Saturday evening?
Relatives who baby-sit regularly can reduce childcare costs and help parents remain in employment.

col: baby-sit for someone｜trông trẻ giúp ai
baby-sit the children｜trông bọn trẻ tạm thời
tip: Thường viết là babysit; quá khứ là baby-sat.

senses.en: able to stick to things, often because of a substance
uncomfortably warm and damp
difficult or awkward to deal with

ex.en: My fingers were sticky after eating the honey cake.
Food packaging often contains sticky residues that must be removed before the materials can be recycled effectively.

col: a sticky situation｜tình huống khó xử
tip: sticky weather là thời tiết oi bức; sticky situation là tình huống khó xử.

senses.en: a physical or mental change that suggests an illness

senses.zh: dấu hiệu; biểu hiện của một vấn đề
senses.en: a sign that an underlying problem exists

ex.en: A sore throat was her first symptom of illness.
High staff turnover can be a symptom of poor management rather than a shortage of skilled workers.

col: symptom of illness｜triệu chứng của bệnh
tip: Thường dùng a symptom of; làm giảm triệu chứng dùng relieve symptoms.

senses.zh: tuần trăng mật; chuyến đi trăng mật
senses.en: A holiday taken by a couple just after their wedding.

senses.zh: giai đoạn êm đẹp ban đầu
senses.en: An early period when a relationship or situation goes well.
To take a holiday together just after getting married.

ex.en: They spent their honeymoon in a quiet seaside village.
Popular honeymoon destinations can support local economies, but excessive tourism may damage fragile coastal environments.

col: on honeymoon｜đang đi hưởng tuần trăng mật
honeymoon destination｜điểm đến cho tuần trăng mật
tip: Anh-Anh thường nói on honeymoon; Anh-Mỹ thường nói on a honeymoon.

senses.en: To express words or writing in another language
To change something into a different form or practical result

ex.en: Could you translate this recipe into English for me?
Governments must translate environmental commitments into practical policies that encourage businesses to reduce emissions.

col: translate into English｜dịch sang tiếng Anh
translate from Chinese｜dịch từ tiếng Trung
translate ideas into action｜biến ý tưởng thành hành động
tip: Dịch từ ngôn ngữ này sang ngôn ngữ khác: translate from… into….

senses.en: A small, simple house, often built from wood.
A room on a ship or passenger space in an aircraft.

ex.en: We spent the weekend in a cabin beside the lake.
Holiday cabins in protected forests should be carefully managed to limit their impact on local wildlife.

col: cabin crew｜phi hành đoàn khoang hành khách
tip: Vừa chỉ ngôi nhà nhỏ trên đất liền, vừa chỉ khoang tàu hoặc khoang máy bay.

senses.en: physical or mental energy used to achieve something

senses.zh: nỗ lực; hoạt động có tổ chức
senses.en: an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal

ex.en: It took considerable effort to push the sofa upstairs.
Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.

col: put effort into｜dồn công sức vào
tip: Nghĩa công sức thì không đếm được; nghĩa một nỗ lực thì đếm được.

senses.en: A person who competes in boxing.

ex.en: The boxer pulled on her gloves before training.
A professional boxer needs disciplined training and adequate recovery time to maintain both performance and long-term health.

col: professional boxer｜võ sĩ quyền anh chuyên nghiệp
amateur boxer｜võ sĩ quyền anh nghiệp dư
heavyweight boxer｜võ sĩ quyền anh hạng nặng
tip: box làm động từ là đánh quyền anh; boxer là võ sĩ quyền anh.

senses.en: A device that stores energy and supplies electricity.
A large set of similar things, especially tests or questions.

ex.en: The torch needs a new battery before our trip.
Improved battery technology could make electric vehicles more affordable and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.

col: a battery of tests｜một loạt bài kiểm tra
tip: Số nhiều là batteries; a battery of có thể chỉ một loạt bài kiểm tra.

senses.en: Things produced for sale or transported for trade.
Movable possessions belonging to a person.

ex.en: The shop sells handmade goods from nearby villages.
Transporting goods by rail rather than road can lower emissions and reduce congestion in urban areas.

tip: goods là danh từ số nhiều; một món hàng có thể nói an item.

senses.en: To send a document or application for consideration
To accept another person's authority or control

ex.en: Please submit your application before the end of Friday.
Researchers must submit their findings for independent review before these can be published in reputable academic journals.

col: submit something to｜nộp cái gì cho
submit to authority｜phục tùng quyền lực
tip: Quá khứ là submitted; submit sth to sb nghĩa là nộp cái gì cho ai.

senses.en: Having reached a particular age.
Very old, especially when describing people.

ex.en: The swimming class welcomes children aged six and above.
Public libraries can support children aged five to twelve by providing free reading activities during school holidays.

col: children aged five｜trẻ em năm tuổi
aged eighteen and over｜từ mười tám tuổi trở lên
tip: Khi chỉ số tuổi phát âm /eɪdʒd/; khi nghĩa là già thì phát âm /ˈeɪdʒɪd/.

senses.en: happening, existing, or being used now
a continuous movement of water, air, or electricity

ex.en: My current flat is much closer to work.
Current policies may need revision as cities face increasing pressure on housing and transport.

col: the current situation｜tình hình hiện tại
tip: Tính từ nghĩa là hiện tại; danh từ có thể chỉ dòng nước hoặc dòng điện.

senses.en: Very surprised and upset by something unexpected.
Feeling strong disapproval at something offensive or wrong.

ex.en: I was shocked to find water flooding the kitchen.
Residents were shocked by the sudden closure of the only hospital serving their rural community.

col: shocked by the news｜bị sốc trước tin tức
tip: shocked mô tả cảm giác của người; shocking mô tả điều gây sốc.

senses.en: extremely tired and lacking energy
completely used up, with nothing remaining

ex.en: After carrying those boxes upstairs, I felt completely exhausted.
Employees who are constantly exhausted may struggle to concentrate, increasing the risk of mistakes at work.

col: physically exhausted｜kiệt sức về thể chất
mentally exhausted｜kiệt quệ về tinh thần
exhausted resources｜nguồn lực đã cạn kiệt
tip: Người cảm thấy mệt dùng exhausted; việc khiến mệt dùng exhausting.

senses.en: The pleasure you get from doing or experiencing something

ex.en: My grandfather gets great enjoyment from feeding the birds.
Schools should encourage reading for enjoyment rather than focusing exclusively on examination performance.

col: get enjoyment from｜tìm thấy niềm vui từ
tip: Thường không đếm được; get enjoyment from nghĩa là tìm thấy niềm vui từ việc gì.

senses.en: Confidence that something is true or someone is capable.
An idea accepted as true, especially about life or religion.

ex.en: Her belief in me helped me try again.
The belief that education improves social mobility influences government spending priorities in many countries.

col: a widely held belief｜quan niệm được nhiều người tin
contrary to popular belief｜trái với quan niệm phổ biến
tip: belief in nghĩa là tin tưởng hoặc có đức tin; belief that + mệnh đề là một quan điểm cụ thể.

senses.en: To burst violently, or cause something to burst violently.
To increase extremely quickly in size, amount, or popularity.
To express strong feelings suddenly and forcefully.

ex.en: We watched colourful fireworks explode above the lake.
Demand for online courses has exploded as more adults seek flexible opportunities to develop new skills.

col: explode into flames｜bùng cháy bất ngờ
explode with anger｜nổi giận đùng đùng
tip: Vật nổ làm chủ ngữ thường dùng dạng chủ động, không cần bị động.

senses.zh: cộng đồng; dân cư địa phương
senses.en: people living in the same area
people sharing interests, beliefs, or a particular background

ex.en: Our community gathers every spring to clean the park.
Public libraries strengthen the local community by providing free learning spaces and opportunities for social interaction.

col: sense of community｜ý thức cộng đồng
tip: Vừa chỉ cư dân cùng khu vực, vừa chỉ nhóm người có chung nền tảng hay sở thích.

senses.zh: ý định; dự định; mục đích
senses.en: Something that you plan or mean to do.

ex.en: I had no intention of staying out so late.
The government announced its intention to expand public transport in order to reduce traffic congestion.

col: have no intention of｜không có ý định
with the intention of｜với ý định
announce an intention to｜tuyên bố ý định
tip: Dùng intention to do hoặc intention of doing.

senses.en: requiring rules to be obeyed and standards to be met

senses.zh: chính xác; nghiêm ngặt (theo nghĩa đã định)
senses.en: following an exact meaning or limit without exceptions

ex.en: Our coach is strict about arriving on time.
Strict environmental regulations can encourage manufacturers to adopt cleaner technologies and reduce harmful industrial emissions.

col: strict about punctuality｜yêu cầu nghiêm ngặt về việc đúng giờ
strict with children｜nghiêm khắc với trẻ em
in the strict sense｜theo nghĩa chặt chẽ
tip: Nghiêm với người dùng with; yêu cầu nghiêm về việc gì dùng about.
